# Home Appliance Cost Guide

> Plain-English repair pricing, home warranty breakdowns, and repair-vs-replace guides for US homeowners.

Home Appliance Cost Guide helps homeowners compare typical repair costs, understand warranty terms, decode common appliance errors, and make repair-or-replace decisions. Estimates are educational national ranges, not quotes. Sources vary by article and may include published industry research, manufacturer documentation, authorized-parts pricing, and publicly available warranty contracts. Readers should verify prices and contract terms with local professionals and providers.

## Important limitations

- Prices vary by location, model, parts availability, labor rate, and diagnosis.
- Warranty terms vary by state and contract version.
- Error codes may vary by model; manufacturer documentation takes priority.
- Safety-critical gas, refrigerant, and high-voltage work belongs with a qualified professional.
